title: Deterministic witness dataflow
requirement: WHEN a WitnessPlan is evaluated, its baseline SHALL execute a typed dependency DAG in a deterministic uncached order to materialize complete StepRecords.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Independent normal comparison baseline
scenarios.when: The same admitted factorial/list/tree or pending-caller state is materialized without caching, with cold caches and with warm caches.
scenarios.then: Stable dependency ordering and explicit bindings produce identical decoded reference prefixes, ordered frames/environments, outcomes and reference-work observations against independently authored expectations. Cache/lifetime/streaming variants retain the uncached baseline; reusable keys include exact program/profile/layout and immutable inputs, while helper visits, copies, live values and memory remain separate diagnostics. Neither those expectations nor semantic behavior are generated from the materializer/DAG metadata.

expected.decoded reference prefixes, ordered fram: identical across uncached, cold-cache and warm-cache materialization
expected.expectations: independently authored, not generated from materializer/DAG metadata

unasserted: the four schedule snapshots are not exposed separately: their agreement is the materializer's flag, backed here by authored decoded states, owner cross-checks and cache/lifetime diagnostics consistency
helper visits/copies/live values/memory are asserted only to stay out of the decoded snapshot; their values are diagnostics

exec.entrypoint: mori simulate --execution-profile sherlock-helper-microstep/1 --source-profile moriarty-sherlock-draft/1 --entry (non-native build) with --chunk-at E / --chunk 100000 --chunk-witness
